# Hermes Proactive Agent

> Hermes Agent plugin (`proactive-agent`) that runs the chat agent like a secretary managing subagents: a turn time budget and background detach for the main agent, a handoff check for delegate_task that attaches the user's recent messages and memory, a repeat stop for subagents, result notes and a persistent task ledger.

- Repository: https://github.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent
- Releases: https://github.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/releases
- Requires: Hermes Agent >= 0.22 (tested on v0.22.7), Python 3.10+
- License: MIT

## Install

```bash
hermes plugins install JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent/proactive-agent
hermes plugins enable proactive-agent
```

The plugin lives in the repository's proactive-agent/ directory. Recommended Hermes setting: `delegation.max_iterations: 60`.

## How it works

Roles: the main agent ("secretary") keeps the chat responsive, investigates, decides and writes the handoffs; subagents ("workers") do the slow execution.

One small step per stage of a task: turn budget (secretary) -> handoff (delegate_task) -> worker limits (subagent) -> results and task ledger (back to the secretary).

Rules throughout: no extra model calls; what Hermes already does (command approval, stale-file protection, step budgets, stall detection, completion delivery) stays with Hermes; the plugin talks only to the secretary, never to the user's chat; a plugin error never blocks a tool.

## Features

### Turn budget
- From 60 s in one turn: a one-time reminder to answer or delegate within 1-2 steps.
- From 120 s: editing and execution tools pause; reading, delegate_task and wrap-up tools remain (memory, todo, clarify, send_message, process_manage list/poll/log/kill).
- A mid-turn user message (steer) resets the budget.
- Foreground terminal commands longer than 30 s move to the background via Hermes' yield path and notify on completion.
- process_manage(action='wait') is refused.

### Handoff (delegate_task)
- context under 120 characters is returned once per turn with a checklist.
- A brief naming a file another running subagent is changing is returned once per turn.
- Accepted tasks get the user's recent messages verbatim, USER.md and MEMORY.md in full, the running subagents and the files they change, this chat's recent unfinished tasks from the ledger, working rules, and a default output_schema (status, summary, evidence, blockers).

### Worker limits
- Same tool, same arguments, same result: a note after 3 repeats, a stop after 5 (the worker must report "blocked"; the secretary is told why and tells the user in one line).
- The step budget is Hermes' delegation.max_iterations.

### Results and task ledger
- When a worker returns, the secretary's next turn notes the reported evidence, missing evidence, an unfinished task or a plugin stop.
- The secretary checks running workers on demand with delegate_task(action='list'); nothing is injected every turn and nothing is posted on a timer.
- Task ledger (SQLite in <hermes home>/plugin-data/proactive-agent/ledger.db, written by hooks only): goal, status, changed files, steers, live transcript path, summary, evidence, blockers. Last 20 finished tasks per chat, up to 7 days.
- Hermes does not resume a finished or restarted subagent; the next worker is briefed with the unfinished task's record, and after a restart the secretary is told which tasks were lost.
- action='stop' marks the task stopped at once; running records with no end expire after 6 hours; result and restart notes are stored in the ledger until the chat's next turn.
- The plugin never posts to the user's chat; it only adds notes for the secretary.

Only platforms in governed_platforms (default ["weixin"]) are affected. Cron runs and subagents of ungoverned sessions are untouched.

## Configuration

Keys under plugins.entries.proactive-agent.settings (environment override: PROACTIVE_<KEY>):

| Key | Default |
|---|---|
| governed_platforms | ["weixin"] |
| terminal_auto_detach_seconds | 30 |
| turn_soft_seconds | 60 |
| turn_hard_seconds | 120 |
| handoff_min_context_chars | 120 |
| worker_repeat_limit | 5 |
